title: mail: header injection and several recipients
setup: Serveur › E-mail set up with the test's fake transport, which records every message.
expectBody: Tries 0 to 3 have ok: false (CR/LF anywhere, or more than one recipient). Tries 4 to 7 may have ok: true, but then the recorded message has exactly one recipient, no Bcc/Cc, the core's From, no Reply-To from the plugin, text only (no HTML part), no attachment, and the core's footer naming the plugin.
afterInCore: The fake transport recorded at most 4 messages, each to a@example.test only. /etc/passwd was never read.
why: nodemailer accepts address lists, html, attachments with a path (it reads the file!), from and replyTo. The core must build the message from to, subject and text only.
